description: Notification sent to student when an academic misconduct case is filed
subject: Academic Misconduct Case Filed - $case_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is to inform you that an academic misconduct case has been filed regarding your academic work.

Case Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Case ID: $case_id
Student Name: $student_name
Student ID: $student_id
Course/Module: $course
Violation Type: $violation_type
Severity Level: $severity
Date Filed: $date_filed
Current Status: $status$assignment_mention
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What This Means:
The Academic Integrity Office has initiated an investigation into a potential violation of the university's academic integrity policies. This case is currently under review.

Your Rights and Responsibilities:
• You have the right to respond to these allegations
• You may be contacted for a hearing or meeting
• You should review the university's academic integrity policy
• Contact the Academic Integrity Office if you have questions

Next Steps:
You will be notified of any further developments in this case. If a hearing is scheduled, you will receive advance notice with the date, time, and location.

Important: Please do not ignore this notification. Failure to respond or participate in the process may result in decisions being made in your absence.

For Questions or Concerns:
Please contact the Office of Academic Integrity at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Academic Misconduct Panel
University Administration

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
